audit_column_comments._load_date: Logical load date of the extract. Re-running a date replaces exactly that date's rows.
audit_column_comments._ingested_at: UTC timestamp when the row was written to this table.
audit_column_comments._source_file: Raw file the row was read from (lineage back to the landed bytes).
audit_column_comments._row_hash: SHA-256 over the business columns; used to detect real changes.
audit_column_comments._updated_at: UTC timestamp when this row was last written by the pipeline.
audit_column_comments.effective_from: UTC timestamp from which this version is valid.
audit_column_comments.effective_to: UTC timestamp until which this version was valid; 9999-12-31 for the current version.
audit_column_comments.is_current: TRUE for the latest version of the business key.

tables.name: customers
tables.comment: Raw CRM customer extract, exactly as received, plus audit columns.

tables.name: sales_orders
tables.comment: Raw web-shop order documents, nested fields still JSON text.

column_comments.ordered_products: JSON array of line items (parsed in Silver).
column_comments.promo_info: JSON array of promotions applied to the order.

tables.name: sales
tables.comment: Raw point-of-sale export, product details still JSON text.

column_comments.product: JSON payload of the product sold (parsed in Silver).
column_comments.total_price: Line total as exported (= price x qty).

tables.name: customers
tables.comment: Conformed customer master with full change history (SCD2). Filter is_current for the latest version.

column_comments.loyalty_segment_name: Loyalty label: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum.
column_comments.is_active: TRUE while the CRM record is still open (no valid_to).
column_comments.crm_valid_from: Validity start of the record in the CRM.
column_comments.crm_valid_to: Validity end in the CRM; NULL while active.

tables.name: sales_orders
tables.comment: Web-shop order headers with change history (SCD2). Line items are in sales_order_lines.

column_comments.source_document_id: Cosmos document id; orders versions of the same order.
column_comments.line_item_count: Actual number of line items (number_of_line_items is the source's own, sometimes stale, count).
column_comments.order_gross_amount: Sum of price x quantity across the lines, before discounts.

tables.name: sales_order_lines
tables.comment: Web-shop order lines, one row per order x line, from the latest version of each order (SCD1).

column_comments.line_number: 1-based position of the line within the order.
column_comments.promo_id: Promotion applied to the line; 'NONE' when there was none.
column_comments.promo_discount_rate: Discount rate applied to the line (0 when none).
column_comments.net_amount: gross_amount - discount_amount. Use this for revenue.

tables.name: sales_order_clicks
tables.comment: Products clicked before checkout, one row per order x product (SCD1).

column_comments.click_count: Number of clicks on the product before checkout.
column_comments.product_id: Clicked product; may not have been ordered.

tables.name: sales
tables.comment: Conformed point-of-sale transactions (SCD1). sale_id is a deterministic hash: the source has no key.

column_comments.sale_id: Deterministic SHA-256 over the business columns; stable across reloads.
column_comments.listed_product_name: Product name from the export; disagrees with the payload for ~70% of rows.
column_comments.product_name: Product actually sold, parsed from the payload (authoritative).
column_comments.brand: Brand as reported by the export.

tables.name: dim_date
tables.comment: Calendar dimension, one row per day 2015-2030. Join facts on *_date_key.

column_comments.date_key: Surrogate key in yyyymmdd form, e.g. 20260907.

tables.name: dim_customer
tables.comment: Customer dimension (SCD2). One row per customer version; customer_sk = -1 is the Unknown member.

column_comments.customer_sk: Surrogate key, unique per customer version. Facts reference this. -1 = Unknown.
column_comments.is_current: TRUE for the latest version. Use customers_current for 'as of today'.

tables.name: dim_product
tables.comment: Product dimension derived from both channels; there is no product master upstream.

column_comments.product_sk: Surrogate key. Facts reference this. -1 = Unknown.
column_comments.brand: Best-effort brand; see brand_source for how confident to be.

tables.name: dim_promotion
tables.comment: Promotion dimension derived from the promotions applied to order lines. 'NONE' = no promotion.

column_comments.promo_id: Promotion code; 'NONE' when no promotion was applied.

tables.name: fact_sales_order_line
tables.comment: Web-shop order lines. GRAIN: one row per order x line, current version of the order.

column_comments.net_amount: Revenue for the line after the promotion discount.
column_comments.order_date_key: FK to dim_date; NULL when the source order had no timestamp.

tables.name: fact_sales_order
tables.comment: Web-shop order headers. GRAIN: one row per order (current version).

column_comments.net_amount: Sum of the line net amounts. Use this for order-level revenue.

tables.name: fact_pos_sale
tables.comment: Store sales. GRAIN: one row per product sold. Not row-linkable to web orders.

column_comments.total_amount: Sale amount (quantity x unit_price). Use this for store revenue.

tables.name: customers_current
tables.comment: Current version of every real customer (excludes the Unknown member).

tables.name: sales_order_lines_obt
tables.comment: One big table: web-shop order lines joined to customer, product, promotion and date. Start here for ad-hoc analysis.

tables.name: pos_sales_obt
tables.comment: One big table: store sales joined to customer, product and date.
